summary: Contra supports a filtered job feed and an Apply action. Its help center says DMs are for networking, not service pitches. Co-Agent supports MCP connectors but account access is being rolled out; this app has no verified outbound Contra API.
steps: Complete the independent profile: cover image/video, four pieces of work, rate, social link, identity verification and wallet setup.
Position your services around CRM/GoHighLevel and automation, with truthful case studies and your actual role in each project.
Filter the Job feed by tools, skills and budgets; save suitable listings here.
Use the listing Apply action for tailored applications; avoid service pitches through Contra DMs.
Review scope, timeline and payment structure; fixed, hourly and milestone escrow differ from invoice billing.
Check platform, processing and payout fees at checkout; a free account does not mean every transaction is free.
Record submitted proposals, client replies, contracts and payments. Check whether your account has Co-Agent and its Connectors tab.
